summary: Layer 1B expansion focused on US-listed or US-tradable assets tied to ABF package substrate materials and copper-bonding/surface-treatment chemistry. The cleanest chokepoint reference remains Ajinomoto’s ABF insulating film, but it is a large diversified Japanese company rather than a pure AI substrate play. The more investable US-listed discovery lane appears to be specialty chemical/process suppliers for IC substrates and advanced packaging, especially MKS/Atotech and Element Solutions/MacDermid Alpha.
